b3.descricao: Upload a file exported from the B3 Investor Area. We'll identify positions and transactions automatically for you to review before saving.

corretora.descricao: Upload a statement exported from your broker. We'll identify positions and transactions automatically.

csv.descricao: Upload a CSV or XLSX with your assets or transactions. We'll identify everything we can for you to review.

pdf.descricao: Upload a PDF statement from your broker or B3. We'll identify positions and transactions for you to review before saving.

upload.dropzone: Click to choose a file or drag it here
upload.privacy: We don't ask for passwords, tax IDs, banking tokens or access to your account. Imports only use files you upload.
upload.errorEmptyFile: This file appears to be empty or in an unsupported format.
upload.errorUnsupported: Unsupported format. Please upload PDF, CSV, XLSX or XLS.
upload.errorNoItems: We were able to open the file, but couldn't identify investments or transactions automatically. You can try another file or add them manually.

processing.title: Reading the file…
processing.description: This can take a few seconds.

aviso.movsOnly: We found transactions in the file. Review the data before saving.
aviso.needsReview: The file was read, but some data needs review before importing.
